review: The Sword Sharpened with Tears Rodion is the 6th Walp exclusive ID with hybrid Charge and Sinking mechanics. Her main gimmick is quite similar yet unique compared to her QoH counterpart Don Quixote. Rodion can also flip between Positive and Negative Coins, but unlike Don, she has no means of being forced out of negative SP stance once she has locked into Negative Coin mode. However, it is a good thing since she cannot go below -40 SP without losing Clash, and the better parts of her kit are locked behind the Negative SP “stance“. To flip into that stance, you need to use your Defensive Skill once, after which she starts to lose SP actively. With more uses of Defensive Skill, she will lose more SP per turn and start to deal more damage, but that is a matter to discuss within the skillset.
